mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns; the current rate of 0.12% predicts positive 20-day returns. The mechanism is always active as a continuous signal without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 216) signals persistent inflationary pressure, reducing equity valuations and predicting negative 20-day S&P 500 returns. The current CPI of 215.791 requires a 0.21-point increase to trigger.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 216, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Stagflationary conditions (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 216) create negative equity returns due to policy constraints. The current FEDFUNDS (0.12%) and CPI (215.791) require CPI to rise 0.21 points to activate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 216, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 10.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to recessionary expectations. The current UNRATE of 10.2% activates the signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (HOUST < 600 and annualized GDPC1 growth > 2%) predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to imminent monetary tightening. Current HOUST (590.0) and GDPC1 (13014.0) require growth to exceed 2% annually.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 600 and GDPC1 growth > 2% (annualized), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust economic activity, predicting positive 5-day S&P 500 returns by reducing recession risk. Current INDPRO (98.46) requires a 1.54-point increase to activate.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer demand (HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 350000) predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to declining housing and retail activity. Current HOUST (590.0) and RSAFS (344688.0) require RSAFS to fall 5312 units to activate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 350000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 580) predict negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to housing market weakness and economic slowdown. Current HOUST (590.0) requires a 10-unit decline to activate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 580, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
